generic_task_evidence_repair.en: Build the smallest task-anchor loop first, inspect negative paths, boundary consistency, audit / reconciliation, and fake-done risk; Guide turns weak evidence into repair, Repair Builder fixes named gaps only, and GateKeeper judges from all handoffs and evidence_query.
generic_task_evidence_repair.zh: 先构建任务锚点最小闭环，再检查负向路径、边界一致性、审计/对账和假完成风险；Guide 把弱证据转成修复，Repair Builder 只补被点名缺口，GateKeeper 汇总所有 handoff 和 evidence_query 后裁决。
generic_task_evidence_repair.es: Construir primero el cierre mínimo del ancla de tarea; inspeccionar rutas negativas, consistencia de límites, auditoría, reconciliación y falso terminado; Guide convierte evidencia débil en reparación, Repair Builder corrige solo brechas nombradas y GateKeeper decide el cierre desde todos los handoffs y evidence_query.

data_residency.en: Use a data residency contract-first workflow: read-only Residency Contract Inspector first freezes EU/US data-plane, tenant residency policy, routing, DB/storage/search/cache/queue/backup/logs/analytics, processor/DPA, key-region, failover, migration/backfill, access/export/audit/trace, and egress-monitoring proof targets; Regional Isolation Builder implements only after that contract handoff; Residency Evidence Inspector reads contract and builder handoffs to verify region proof, wrong-region write/read/export, processor mismatch, stale policy, key, failover, migration, access/export/audit/trace, and monitoring; GateKeeper combines all handoffs and evidence_query and fails closed on UI-region-only, env-var-only, tenant-field-only, one-routed-request-only, docs-only DPA, or missing wrong-region negatives / egress alerts / key-region proof; Weak, Unproven, Blocking, and fake-done gaps must surface before closure; residency proof beats pragmatic progress, so a region selector or one routed request cannot substitute real regional proof.
data_residency.zh: 使用 data residency contract-first workflow：只读 Residency Contract Inspector 先固定 EU/US 数据面、tenant residency policy、routing、DB/storage/search/cache/queue/backup/logs/analytics、processor/DPA、key-region、failover、migration/backfill、access/export/audit/trace 和 egress monitoring proof targets；Regional Isolation Builder 读取 contract handoff 后才实现；Residency Evidence Inspector 读取 contract 与 builder handoff，验证 region proof、wrong-region write/read/export、processor mismatch、stale policy、key、failover、migration、access/export/audit/trace 和 monitoring；GateKeeper 汇总所有 handoff 和 evidence_query，对 UI-region-only、env-var-only、tenant-field-only、one-routed-request-only、docs-only DPA 或缺少错区负向 / egress alert / key-region proof fail closed；Weak、Unproven、Blocking 和假完成缺口必须在 closure 前暴露。驻留证据优先于务实进度，不能用 region selector 或单次 routed request 代替真实区域证明。
data_residency.es: Usar workflow data residency contract-first: Residency Contract Inspector fija inventario EU/US, residency policy, routing, DB/storage/search/cache/queue/backup/logs/analytics, processor/DPA, key-region, failover, migration, access/export/audit/trace y egress monitoring targets; Regional Isolation Builder implementa desde ese handoff; Residency Evidence Inspector lee contract y builder handoffs para verificar region proof, wrong-region write/read/export, processor mismatch, stale policy, keys, failover, migration, access/export/audit/trace y monitoring; GateKeeper combina todo y fail closed ante UI-region-only, env-var-only, tenant-field-only, one-routed-request-only, docs-only DPA o falta de negativos / egress alerts / key-region proof; Weak, Unproven, Blocking, fake-done gaps must surface before closure; residency proof beats pragmatic progress, so region selector or one routed request cannot substitute real regional proof.

support_impersonation.en: Use a support impersonation policy-first workflow: read-only Break-glass Policy Inspector first freezes approval, consent, time limit, attribution, MFA/step-up, privacy, tenant, audit, revoke, expiry, monitoring, and export-attempt proof targets; Break-glass Builder builds only from that handoff; Access Evidence Inspector reads policy and builder handoffs to verify negative, privacy, tenant, revoke, expiry, audit, and monitoring evidence; GateKeeper combines all handoffs and evidence_query so shared-token, login-as happy path, banner-only, Weak, Unproven, Blocking, or fake-done states are exposed before closure and fail closed.
support_impersonation.zh: 使用 support impersonation policy-first workflow：先由只读 Break-glass Policy Inspector 固定 approval、consent、time limit、attribution、MFA/step-up、privacy、tenant、audit、revoke、expiry、monitoring 和 export-attempt proof targets；Break-glass Builder 读取该 handoff 后只构建可审计路径；Access Evidence Inspector 读取 policy 与 builder handoff，验证负向、隐私、租户、撤销、过期、审计和监控证据；GateKeeper 汇总所有 handoff 和 evidence_query，让 shared-token、login-as happy path、banner-only、Weak、Unproven、Blocking 或 fake-done 状态在 closure 前暴露并 fail closed。
support_impersonation.es: Usar support impersonation policy-first workflow: Break-glass Policy Inspector fija approval, consent, time limit, attribution, MFA, privacy, tenant, audit, revoke, expiry, monitoring y export proof targets; Builder implementa desde ese handoff; Evidence Inspector verifica negativos, privacy, tenant, revoke, audit y monitoring; GateKeeper combina handoffs y evidence_query para exponer shared-token, login-as, banner-only, Weak, Unproven, Blocking o fake-done antes del cierre y fail closed.

kyc_aml_screening.en: Use a KYC/AML compliance-contract-first workflow: read-only Compliance Contract Inspector first freezes provider contracts, jurisdiction / retention, KYC/KYB fields, sanctions / PEP / watchlist samples, manual review rubric, appeal / resubmission, rescreening cadence, webhook signature / replay / order / idempotency, audit reason schema, privacy redaction, monitoring, and payout ledger proof targets; KYC/AML Builder implements only after that handoff; Screening Evidence Inspector and Financial Controls Inspector read contract plus builder handoffs in one parallel_group, separately refuting screening / document / provider / webhook and payout / ledger / retention / privacy / audit / monitoring claims; GateKeeper combines all handoffs and evidence_query and fails closed on sandbox-approved-only, UI-verified-only, provider-status-only, happy-path webhook, weak manual review, missing sanctions negatives, or missing payout ledger proof.
kyc_aml_screening.zh: 使用 KYC/AML compliance-contract-first workflow：只读 Compliance Contract Inspector 先固定 provider contract、jurisdiction / retention、KYC/KYB fields、sanctions/PEP/watchlist samples、manual review rubric、appeal/resubmission、rescreening、webhook、audit reason、privacy、monitoring 和 payout ledger proof targets；KYC/AML Builder 读取 contract handoff 后才实现；Screening Evidence Inspector 与 Financial Controls Inspector 使用同一个 parallel_group 并行读取 contract 与 builder handoff，分别反证筛查/证件/provider/webhook 和 payout/ledger/retention/privacy/audit/monitoring；GateKeeper 汇总所有 handoff 和 evidence_query，对 sandbox-approved-only、UI-verified-only、provider-status-only、happy-path webhook、manual review 弱证据、sanctions 负例缺失或 payout ledger 缺失 fail closed。
kyc_aml_screening.es: Usar workflow KYC/AML compliance-contract-first: Compliance Contract Inspector fija provider contracts, jurisdiction/retention, KYC/KYB fields, sanctions/PEP/watchlist samples, manual review, appeal, rescreening, webhooks, audit reasons, privacy, monitoring y payout ledger targets; KYC/AML Builder implementa desde ese handoff; Screening Evidence Inspector y Financial Controls Inspector leen contract y builder handoffs en el mismo parallel_group, refutando screening/provider/webhook y payout/ledger/privacy/audit/monitoring; GateKeeper combina todo y fail closed ante sandbox-only, UI-only, provider-status-only, happy-path webhook, manual review débil o falta de sanctions negatives / payout ledger.

payment_webhook_ledger.en: Use a payment webhook contract-first workflow: read-only Webhook Contract Inspector first freezes provider schemas, signature/timestamp, replay/idempotency, ordering, retry/DLQ, ledger/dispute/payout state machines, audit/privacy, monitoring, and manual replay proof targets; Payment Webhook Builder implements only after that contract handoff; Webhook Evidence Inspector and Ledger Reconciliation Inspector read contract plus builder handoffs in one parallel_group, separately refuting signature/replay/order/retry/DLQ and ledger/dispute/payout/audit/privacy/monitoring claims; GateKeeper combines all handoffs and evidence_query and fails closed on happy-path-webhook-only, unsigned dev-mode, provider-status-only, database-constraint-only dedupe, docs-only contract, or missing replay/order/ledger/DLQ/monitoring proof; Weak, Unproven, Blocking, and fake-done gaps must surface before closure, and webhook plus ledger proof beats pragmatic progress.
payment_webhook_ledger.zh: 使用 payment webhook contract-first workflow：只读 Webhook Contract Inspector 先固定 provider schema、signature/timestamp、replay/idempotency、ordering、retry/DLQ、ledger/dispute/payout state machines、audit/privacy、monitoring 和 manual replay proof targets；Payment Webhook Builder 读取 contract handoff 后才实现；Webhook Evidence Inspector 与 Ledger Reconciliation Inspector 使用同一个 parallel_group 并行读取 contract 与 builder handoff，分别反证 signature/replay/order/retry/DLQ 和 ledger/dispute/payout/audit/privacy/monitoring；GateKeeper 汇总所有 handoff 和 evidence_query，对 happy-path-webhook-only、unsigned dev-mode、provider-status-only、database-constraint-only dedupe、docs-only contract、missing replay/order/ledger/DLQ/monitoring proof fail closed；Weak、Unproven、Blocking 和假完成缺口必须在 closure 前暴露，webhook 与 ledger proof 优先于务实进度。
payment_webhook_ledger.es: Usar payment webhook contract-first workflow: Webhook Contract Inspector fija schemas, signature/timestamp, replay/idempotency, ordering, retry/DLQ, ledger/dispute/payout state machines, audit/privacy, monitoring y manual replay targets; Payment Webhook Builder implementa desde ese handoff; Webhook Evidence Inspector y Ledger Reconciliation Inspector leen contract y builder handoffs en el mismo parallel_group, refutando signature/replay/order/retry/DLQ y ledger/dispute/payout/audit/privacy/monitoring; GateKeeper combina todo y fail closed ante happy-path-only, unsigned dev-mode, provider-status-only, database-constraint-only dedupe, docs-only contract o falta de replay/order/ledger/DLQ/monitoring proof; Weak, Unproven, Blocking, fake-done gaps surface before closure, and webhook plus ledger proof beats pragmatic progress.

identity_sso.en: Use an identity SSO contract-first workflow: read-only Identity Contract Inspector first freezes IdP metadata, issuer/audience, assertion signature, tenant domain binding, replay/expiry, SCIM/JIT provisioning, deprovisioning, role/group mapping, password-login compatibility, audit, and monitoring proof targets; SSO Builder implements only after that contract handoff; SSO Assertion Evidence Inspector and Provisioning Mapping Inspector read contract plus builder handoffs in one parallel_group, separately refuting metadata/signature/issuer/audience/replay/tenant/session/audit and SCIM/JIT/role mapping/deprovisioning/compatibility/monitoring claims; GateKeeper combines all handoffs and evidence_query and fails closed on Okta-happy-path-only, SAML-library-only, UI-enabled-only, admin-only mapping, missing forged assertion negatives, missing tenant-binding proof, missing deprovisioning proof, or missing audit/monitoring proof; Weak, Unproven, Blocking, and fake-done gaps must surface before closure, and identity contract plus provisioning lifecycle proof beats fast login progress.
identity_sso.zh: 使用 identity SSO contract-first workflow：只读 Identity Contract Inspector 先固定 IdP metadata、issuer/audience、assertion signature、tenant domain binding、replay/expiry、SCIM/JIT provisioning、deprovisioning、role/group mapping、password-login compatibility、audit 和 monitoring proof targets；SSO Builder 读取 contract handoff 后才实现；SSO Assertion Evidence Inspector 与 Provisioning Mapping Inspector 使用同一个 parallel_group 并行读取 contract 与 builder handoff，分别反证 metadata/signature/issuer/audience/replay/tenant/session/audit 和 SCIM/JIT/role mapping/deprovisioning/compatibility/monitoring；GateKeeper 汇总所有 handoff 和 evidence_query，对 Okta-happy-path-only、SAML-library-only、UI-enabled-only、admin-only mapping、missing forged assertion negatives、missing tenant-binding proof、missing deprovisioning proof 或 missing audit/monitoring proof fail closed；Weak、Unproven、Blocking 和假完成缺口必须在 closure 前暴露，identity contract 与 provisioning lifecycle proof 优先于快速登录进度。
identity_sso.es: Usar identity SSO contract-first workflow: Identity Contract Inspector fija metadata, issuer/audience, assertion signature, tenant binding, replay/expiry, SCIM/JIT, deprovisioning, role/group mapping, compatibility, audit y monitoring targets; SSO Builder implementa desde ese handoff; SSO Assertion Evidence Inspector y Provisioning Mapping Inspector leen contract y builder handoffs en el mismo parallel_group, refutando metadata/signature/issuer/audience/replay/tenant/session/audit y SCIM/JIT/role mapping/deprovisioning/compatibility/monitoring; GateKeeper combina todo y fail closed ante Okta-happy-path-only, SAML-library-only, UI-enabled-only, admin-only mapping o falta de forged assertion / tenant binding / deprovisioning / audit-monitoring proof; Weak, Unproven, Blocking, fake-done gaps surface before closure, and identity contract plus provisioning lifecycle proof beats fast login progress.

key_rotation.en: Use a key rotation contract-first workflow: read-only Key Rotation Contract Inspector first freezes old/new overlap, zero-downtime, revoke/revoked-key negatives, scope/tenant binding, hash/KMS storage, expiry/last-used telemetry, rollback, audit fields, and monitoring targets; Secret Rotation Builder implements only after that contract handoff; Rotation Lifecycle Evidence Inspector and Secret Storage Audit Inspector read contract plus builder handoffs in one parallel_group, separately refuting overlap/revoke/scope/tenant/expiry/rollback/monitoring and storage/plaintext/audit/privacy/governance claims; GateKeeper combines all handoffs and evidence_query and fails closed on new-key-only UI, env-var-only, happy-path API call only, docs-only rotation, missing revoked-key negative, or missing overlap/storage/audit/monitoring proof; Weak, Unproven, Blocking, and fake-done gaps must surface before closure, and key lifecycle plus storage/audit proof beats fast new-key progress.
key_rotation.zh: 使用 key rotation contract-first workflow：只读 Key Rotation Contract Inspector 先固定 old/new overlap、zero-downtime、revoke/revoked-key negatives、scope/tenant binding、hash/KMS storage、expiry/last-used telemetry、rollback、audit fields 和 monitoring targets；Secret Rotation Builder 读取 contract handoff 后才实现；Rotation Lifecycle Evidence Inspector 与 Secret Storage Audit Inspector 使用同一个 parallel_group 并行读取 contract 与 builder handoff，分别反证 overlap/revoke/scope/tenant/expiry/rollback/monitoring 和 storage/plaintext/audit/privacy/governance；GateKeeper 汇总所有 handoff 和 evidence_query，对 new-key-only UI、env-var-only、happy-path API call only、docs-only rotation、missing revoked-key negative、missing overlap/storage/audit/monitoring proof fail closed；Weak、Unproven、Blocking 和假完成缺口必须在 closure 前暴露，key lifecycle 与 storage/audit proof 优先于快速展示新 key。
key_rotation.es: Usar key rotation contract-first workflow: Key Rotation Contract Inspector fija overlap, zero-downtime, revoke/revoked negatives, scope/tenant, hash/KMS storage, expiry/telemetry, rollback, audit fields y monitoring targets; Secret Rotation Builder implementa desde ese handoff; Rotation Lifecycle Evidence Inspector y Secret Storage Audit Inspector leen contract y builder handoffs en el mismo parallel_group, refutando lifecycle/monitoring y storage/audit/privacy/governance; GateKeeper combina todo y fail closed ante new-key-only UI, env-var-only, happy-path-only, docs-only rotation o missing revoked/overlap/storage/audit/monitoring proof; Weak, Unproven, Blocking, fake-done gaps surface before closure, and key lifecycle plus storage/audit proof beats fast new-key progress.

prompt_asset_ownership.en: Use a prompt asset ownership contract-first workflow: read-only Prompt Surface Contract Inspector first freezes fixed system/developer prompt surfaces, role metadata descriptions, Strategy Source non-fixed boundaries, and locale-neutral system_prompt asset rules; Prompt Asset Builder migrates remaining instruction bodies only after that contract handoff; Prompt Asset Ownership Inspector and Runtime Prompt Rendering Inspector read contract plus builder handoffs in one parallel_group, separately refuting code inline bodies / locale refs / weakened tests / missing refs and rendered prompt semantic drift / placeholder gaps / role metadata rendering / Strategy Source boundary regressions; GateKeeper combines all handoffs and evidence_query and fails closed on inline system-style prompt bodies, locale-specific system_prompt branches, missing asset-ref proof, placeholder gaps, Strategy Source boundary leaks, or local-governance gaps.
prompt_asset_ownership.zh: 使用 prompt asset ownership contract-first workflow：只读 Prompt Surface Contract Inspector 先固定 fixed system/developer prompt surfaces、role metadata descriptions、Strategy Source 非固定边界和 locale-neutral system_prompt asset rules；Prompt Asset Builder 读取 contract handoff 后才迁移剩余 instruction body；Prompt Asset Ownership Inspector 与 Runtime Prompt Rendering Inspector 使用同一个 parallel_group 并行读取 contract 与 builder handoff，分别反证 code inline body / locale refs / weakened tests / missing refs 和 rendered prompt semantic drift / placeholder gaps / role metadata rendering / Strategy Source boundary regressions；GateKeeper 汇总所有 handoff 和 evidence_query，对 inline system-style prompt body、locale-specific system_prompt branch、缺少 asset ref proof、placeholder 漏洞、Strategy Source 边界泄漏或本地治理缺失 fail closed。
prompt_asset_ownership.es: Usar prompt asset ownership contract-first workflow: Prompt Surface Contract Inspector fija surfaces, metadata, Strategy Source boundaries y locale-neutral rules; Prompt Asset Builder migra solo desde ese handoff; Prompt Asset Ownership Inspector y Runtime Prompt Rendering Inspector leen contract y builder handoffs en el mismo parallel_group, refutando inline/locale/weakened-test/missing-ref gaps y rendering/placeholder/metadata/Strategy Source regressions; GateKeeper fail closed ante inline bodies, locale branches, missing ref proof, placeholder gaps, Strategy Source leakage o missing governance.

backup_restore_recovery.en: Use a backup restore recovery contract-first workflow: read-only Backup Recovery Contract Inspector first freezes nightly backup, PITR, cross-region snapshot restore, encryption key access, retention/legal hold, schema migration restore, tenant/full restore, RPO/RTO, integrity, monitoring, permission, and audit targets; Backup Restore Builder implements only after that contract handoff; Restore Drill Evidence Inspector and Retention Security Audit Inspector read contract plus builder handoffs in one parallel_group, separately refuting restore drill/PITR/cross-region/schema migration/tenant/full restore/integrity/RPO/RTO and retention/legal hold/key access/permission/audit/monitoring/governance claims; GateKeeper combines all handoffs and evidence_query and fails closed on backup-job-green-only, snapshot-file-only, dashboard-green-only, missing restore drill, missing PITR, missing integrity proof, missing RPO/RTO, missing retention/legal hold, missing permission, missing audit, or missing monitoring proof. Weak, Unproven, Blocking, and fake-done gaps must surface before closure, and recovery, integrity, key/permission, and audit proof beats fast green status.
backup_restore_recovery.zh: 使用 backup restore recovery contract-first workflow：只读 Backup Recovery Contract Inspector 先固定 nightly backup、PITR、cross-region snapshot restore、encryption key access、retention/legal hold、schema migration restore、tenant/full restore、RPO/RTO、integrity、monitoring、permission 和 audit targets；Backup Restore Builder 读取 contract handoff 后才实现；Restore Drill Evidence Inspector 与 Retention Security Audit Inspector 使用同一个 parallel_group 并行读取 contract 与 builder handoff，分别反证 restore drill/PITR/cross-region/schema migration/tenant/full restore/integrity/RPO/RTO 和 retention/legal hold/key access/permission/audit/monitoring/governance；GateKeeper 汇总所有 handoff 和 evidence_query，对 backup-job-green-only、snapshot-file-only、dashboard-green-only、missing restore drill/PITR/integrity/RPO-RTO/retention/permission/audit/monitoring proof fail closed。Weak、Unproven、Blocking 和假完成缺口必须在 closure 前暴露，可恢复性、完整性、密钥/权限与审计证据优先于快速绿色状态。
backup_restore_recovery.es: Usar backup restore recovery contract-first workflow: Backup Recovery Contract Inspector fija backup/PITR/cross-region/key/retention/migration/tenant/full/RPO/RTO/integrity/monitoring/permission/audit targets; Backup Restore Builder implementa desde ese handoff; Restore Drill Evidence Inspector y Retention Security Audit Inspector leen contract y builder handoffs en el mismo parallel_group, refutando restore/integrity/timing y retention/key/permission/audit/monitoring/governance; GateKeeper fail closed ante green-only, snapshot-only, dashboard-only o missing restore/PITR/integrity/RPO-RTO/retention/permission/audit/monitoring proof.Weak, Unproven, Blocking, and fake-done gaps surface before closure, and recovery, integrity, key/permission, and audit proof beats fast green status.

audit_log_integrity_retention.en: Use an audit log integrity/retention contract-first workflow: read-only Audit Contract Inspector first freezes create/update/delete, permission-change, and failed-attempt event matrix; actor/subject/tenant/request/IP/user-agent/diff/reason/timestamp/sequence fields; PII/token redaction; append-only/hash-chain/WORM integrity; clock skew; retention/legal hold; SIEM/export reconciliation; tenant access; retry semantics; failure alerts; migration; and local-governance proof targets; Audit Trail Builder implements only after that contract handoff; Audit Integrity Inspector and Retention Export Inspector read contract plus builder handoffs in one parallel_group, separately refuting operation/failed-attempt fixtures / required fields / redaction / timestamp-clock-skew / tamper negatives / sequence gaps / retry idempotency / tenant negative access and retention-legal-hold / WORM-hash-chain / SIEM-export reconciliation / stale exporter-logging failure alerts / access permissions / migration / governance claims; the parallel Inspectors expose Weak, Unproven, fake-done, or Blocking audit proof gaps early instead of waiting for final feedback; GateKeeper combines all handoffs and evidence_query and fails closed on database-row-only, console-log-only, UI-history-only, reviewability-only, missing tamper negative, missing retention/legal hold, missing export reconciliation, missing tenant negative, missing redaction, missing retry proof, missing monitoring, missing migration, or skipped local governance.
audit_log_integrity_retention.zh: 使用 audit log integrity/retention contract-first workflow：只读 Audit Contract Inspector 先固定 create/update/delete、permission change、failed attempt event matrix、actor/subject/tenant/request/IP/user-agent/diff/reason/timestamp/sequence fields、PII/token redaction、append-only/hash-chain/WORM integrity、clock skew、retention/legal hold、SIEM/export reconciliation、tenant access、retry semantics、failure alerts、migration 和 local governance proof targets；Audit Trail Builder 读取 contract handoff 后才实现；Audit Integrity Inspector 与 Retention Export Inspector 使用同一个 parallel_group 并行读取 contract 与 builder handoff，分别反证 operation/failed-attempt fixtures、required fields、redaction、timestamp/clock skew、tamper negatives、sequence gaps、retry idempotency、tenant negative access，以及 retention/legal hold、WORM/hash-chain、SIEM/export reconciliation、stale exporter/logging failure alerts、access permissions、migration 和 governance claims；并行 Inspector 必须提前暴露 Weak、Unproven、fake-done 或 Blocking audit proof gaps，而不是等最终反馈才发现；GateKeeper 汇总所有 handoff 和 evidence_query，对 database-row-only、console-log-only、UI-history-only、reviewability-only、missing tamper negative、missing retention/legal hold、missing export reconciliation、missing tenant negative、missing redaction、missing retry proof、missing monitoring、missing migration 或 skipped local governance fail closed。
audit_log_integrity_retention.es: Usar audit log integrity/retention contract-first workflow: Audit Contract Inspector fija event matrix, required fields, redaction, append-only/hash-chain/WORM integrity, clock skew, retention/legal hold, SIEM/export reconciliation, tenant access, retry semantics, failure alerts, migration y governance; Audit Trail Builder implementa desde ese handoff; Audit Integrity Inspector y Retention Export Inspector leen contract y builder handoffs en el mismo parallel_group, refutando operation fixtures, fields, redaction, timestamp, tamper negatives, sequence gaps, retry, tenant negatives, y retention/legal hold, WORM/hash-chain, export reconciliation, alerts, access, migration y governance; los Inspectors exponen pronto Weak, Unproven, fake-done o Blocking audit proof gaps antes del feedback final; GateKeeper fail closed ante row-only, console-only, UI-history-only, reviewability-only, missing tamper, retention, export reconciliation, tenant negatives, redaction, retry, monitoring, migration o governance omitida.

file_upload_storage_safety.en: Use a file upload storage-safety contract-first workflow: read-only Upload Storage Contract Inspector first freezes MIME/content sniffing, extension/content mismatch cases, size limits, malware fixtures, quarantine state machine, private bucket/object ACL, signed URL permission/expiry, tenant object-key isolation, failed upload cleanup, orphan cleanup, audit fields, monitoring, and local-governance proof targets; File Upload Builder implements only after that contract handoff; Storage Access Inspector and Malware Cleanup Inspector read contract plus builder handoffs in one parallel_group, separately refuting private ACL / signed URL auth-expiry / tenant negative access / object-key isolation / public exposure monitoring and MIME spoofing / oversize rejection / malware scan / quarantine-before-serving / failed-orphan cleanup / audit verdict fields / scan failure alerts / governance claims; GateKeeper combines all handoffs and evidence_query and fails closed on returned-URL-only, happy PDF only, browser-content-type-only, public bucket, scan follow-up, missing quarantine, missing tenant negatives, missing cleanup, missing audit/monitoring, or skipped local governance. Weak, Unproven, Blocking, and fake-done gaps must surface before closure, and GateKeeper finishes only when upload validation, object access control, isolation, malware quarantine, cleanup, audit, and monitoring evidence support the task contract.
file_upload_storage_safety.zh: 使用 file upload storage-safety contract-first workflow：只读 Upload Storage Contract Inspector 先固定 MIME/content sniffing、extension/content mismatch、size limits、malware fixtures、quarantine state machine、private bucket/object ACL、signed URL permission/expiry、tenant object-key isolation、failed upload cleanup、orphan cleanup、audit fields、monitoring 和 local governance proof targets；File Upload Builder 读取 contract handoff 后才实现；Storage Access Inspector 与 Malware Cleanup Inspector 使用同一个 parallel_group 并行读取 contract 与 builder handoff，分别反证 private ACL、signed URL auth/expiry、tenant negative access、object-key isolation、public exposure monitoring，以及 MIME spoofing、oversize rejection、malware scan、quarantine-before-serving、failed/orphan cleanup、audit verdict fields、scan failure alerts 和 governance claims；GateKeeper 汇总所有 handoff 和 evidence_query，对 returned-URL-only、happy PDF only、browser-content-type-only、public bucket、scan follow-up、missing quarantine、missing tenant negatives、missing cleanup、missing audit/monitoring 或 skipped local governance fail closed。Weak、Unproven、Blocking 和 fake-done 缺口必须在 closure 前暴露，GateKeeper 只有在上传验证、对象访问控制、隔离、恶意文件隔离、清理、审计和监控证据都支持任务契约时才 finish。
file_upload_storage_safety.es: Usar file upload storage-safety contract-first workflow: Upload Storage Contract Inspector fija MIME/content sniffing, mismatch cases, size limits, malware fixtures, quarantine state machine, ACL privado, signed URL permission/expiry, tenant key isolation, cleanup, audit, monitoring y governance targets; File Upload Builder implementa desde ese handoff; Storage Access Inspector y Malware Cleanup Inspector leen contract y builder handoffs en el mismo parallel_group, refutando ACL/signed URL/tenant negatives/key isolation/public exposure y MIME spoofing/oversize/malware/quarantine/cleanup/audit/alerts/governance; GateKeeper fail closed ante returned-URL-only, happy PDF only, browser-content-type-only, public bucket, scan follow-up, missing quarantine, tenant negatives, cleanup, audit/monitoring o governance omitida. Weak, Unproven, Blocking, and fake-done gaps surface before closure, and GateKeeper finishes only when upload validation, object access control, isolation, malware quarantine, cleanup, audit, and monitoring evidence support the task contract.

auth_session_token_lifecycle.en: Use an auth session/token lifecycle contract-first workflow: read-only Session Token Contract Inspector first freezes access/refresh token expiry, refresh rotation, reuse detection, logout/all-device revocation, password reset invalidation, MFA step-up invalidation, cookie flags, CSRF/API boundaries, tenant/device/session audit fields, monitoring, migration, and local-governance proof targets; Session Token Builder implements only after that contract handoff; Token Misuse Inspector and Session Revocation Audit Inspector read contract plus builder handoffs in one parallel_group, separately refuting expired/revoked/stolen/replayed/reused token negatives / refresh reuse / cookie-CSRF-API boundary / tenant negatives / replay alerts and logout current-all-device revocation / password reset-MFA invalidation / audit trail / monitoring / compatibility-migration / governance claims; GateKeeper combines all handoffs and evidence_query and fails closed on login/logout happy path, frontend-only clear, framework defaults, short-expiry-only, missing token negatives, missing refresh reuse proof, missing session invalidation, missing audit/monitoring, missing migration, or skipped local governance. Weak, Unproven, Blocking, and fake-done gaps must surface before closure, and GateKeeper finishes only when token expiry/rotation/reuse, revocation/invalidation, cookie/CSRF/API boundaries, audit, monitoring, and migration evidence support the task contract.
auth_session_token_lifecycle.zh: 使用 auth session/token lifecycle contract-first workflow：只读 Session Token Contract Inspector 先固定 access/refresh token expiry、refresh rotation、reuse detection、logout/all-device revocation、password reset invalidation、MFA step-up invalidation、cookie flags、CSRF/API boundaries、tenant/device/session audit fields、monitoring、migration 和 local governance proof targets；Session Token Builder 读取 contract handoff 后才实现；Token Misuse Inspector 与 Session Revocation Audit Inspector 使用同一个 parallel_group 并行读取 contract 与 builder handoff，分别反证 expired/revoked/stolen/replayed/reused token negatives、refresh reuse、cookie/CSRF/API boundary、tenant negatives、replay alerts，以及 logout current/all-device revocation、password reset/MFA invalidation、audit trail、monitoring、compatibility/migration 和 governance claims；GateKeeper 汇总所有 handoff 和 evidence_query，对 login/logout happy path、frontend-only clear、framework defaults、short-expiry-only、missing token negatives、missing refresh reuse proof、missing session invalidation、missing audit/monitoring、missing migration 或 skipped local governance fail closed。Weak、Unproven、Blocking 和 fake-done 缺口必须在 closure 前暴露，GateKeeper 只有在 token expiry/rotation/reuse、撤销/失效、cookie/CSRF/API boundary、审计、监控和迁移证据都支持任务契约时才 finish。
auth_session_token_lifecycle.es: Usar auth session/token lifecycle contract-first workflow: Session Token Contract Inspector fija expiry access/refresh, refresh rotation, reuse detection, logout/all-device revocation, password reset/MFA invalidation, cookie flags, CSRF/API boundaries, audit, monitoring, migration y governance targets; Session Token Builder implementa desde ese handoff; Token Misuse Inspector y Session Revocation Audit Inspector leen contract y builder handoffs en el mismo parallel_group, refutando expired/revoked/stolen/replayed/reused token negatives, refresh reuse, cookie/CSRF/API boundary, tenant negatives, replay alerts, y logout revocation, password reset/MFA invalidation, audit, monitoring, compatibility/migration y governance; GateKeeper fail closed ante login/logout happy path, frontend-only clear, framework defaults, short-expiry-only, missing token negatives, refresh reuse, session invalidation, audit/monitoring, migration o governance omitida. Weak, Unproven, Blocking, and fake-done gaps surface before closure, and GateKeeper finishes only when token expiry/rotation/reuse, revocation/invalidation, cookie/CSRF/API boundaries, audit, monitoring, and migration evidence support the task contract.

authorization_policy.en: Use an authorization policy parallel-inspection workflow: Policy Builder first builds the smallest shared policy decision and trace; Contract Inspector and Security Evidence Inspector read the same Builder handoff in one parallel_group, separately verifying matrix/rollout/compat and attacking negative auth, tenant, stale cache, export, job, field leakage, and audit proof; GateKeeper combines both parallel handoffs and evidence_query so Weak, Unproven, Blocking, or fake-done states are exposed before closure and fail closed.
authorization_policy.zh: 使用 authorization policy parallel-inspection workflow：Policy Builder 先构建最小共享 policy decision 并留下 trace；Contract Inspector 与 Security Evidence Inspector 使用同一个 parallel_group 并行读取 Builder handoff，分别验证 permission matrix / rollout / compat 和攻击负向授权 / 串租户 / stale cache / export / job / field leakage / audit；GateKeeper 汇总两个并行 handoff 和 evidence_query，任一检查 Weak、Unproven、Blocking 或 fake-done 都在 closure 前暴露并 fail closed。
authorization_policy.es: Usar authorization policy parallel-inspection workflow: Policy Builder crea el corte mínimo y trace; Contract Inspector y Security Evidence Inspector leen el mismo Builder handoff en un parallel_group, verificando matriz/rollout/compat y atacando negativos/tenant/cache/export/job/audit; GateKeeper combina ambos handoffs y evidence_query para exponer Weak, Unproven, Blocking o fake-done antes del cierre y fail closed.

incident_root_cause.en: Use an incident root-cause workflow: first a read-only Repro Inspector pins reproduction evidence, trigger conditions, and failure mode; Incident Builder repairs only from that handoff and leaves regression guard plus release / rollback handoff; Monitoring Inspector verifies recurrence detection, monitoring / alerts, runbook, and rollback; GateKeeper fails closed on narrative-only root cause, patch-not-tied-to-repro, missing monitoring / rollback, or local-governance gaps, exposing Weak, Unproven, Blocking, and fake-done states before closure.
incident_root_cause.zh: 使用 incident root-cause workflow：先只读固定复现证据、触发条件和 failure mode；Incident Builder 只能基于 Repro handoff 修最小 root cause 并留下 regression guard 与 release / rollback handoff；Monitoring Inspector 验证复发检测、监控 / 告警、runbook 和回滚；GateKeeper 对叙述式 root cause、patch 未绑定复现、缺少 monitoring / rollback 或本地治理缺口 fail closed，让 Weak、Unproven、Blocking 和 fake-done 状态在 closure 前暴露。
incident_root_cause.es: Usar incident root-cause workflow: primero Repro Inspector fija repro, triggers y failure mode en modo solo lectura; Incident Builder corrige solo desde ese handoff y deja regression guard y release/rollback; Monitoring Inspector verifica recurrencia, alertas, runbook y rollback; GateKeeper falla cerrado ante root cause narrativo, patch no ligado a repro, falta de monitoring/rollback o governance, exponiendo Weak, Unproven, Blocking y fake-done antes del cierre.

schedule_phase.en: Use a schedule timezone recurrence contract-first workflow: read-only Schedule Contract Inspector first freezes timezone source, user timezone fallback, local Monday 09:00 semantics, DST spring-forward/fall-back samples, missed-run catch-up window, retry/provider replay idempotency key, subscription/disabled/tenant/locale filters, provider delivery/failure surface, audit fields, monitoring, migration, and local-governance proof targets; Digest Scheduler Builder implements only after that contract handoff; Temporal Correctness Inspector and Delivery Audit Inspector read contract plus builder handoffs in one parallel_group, separately refuting multi-timezone local time / DST boundaries / missed-run catch-up once / duplicate retry-replay negatives / timezone version drift and unsubscribe-disabled-tenant-locale negatives / provider reconciliation / scheduled_at-due_at-sent_at-skipped_reason-timezone_version-job_run_id audit / monitoring / compatibility / governance claims; GateKeeper combines all handoffs and evidence_query and fails closed on cron-only, local-trigger-only, UTC-only, single-timezone-only, provider-accepted-only, missing DST boundary, missing catch-up/idempotency negative, missing unsubscribe/disabled negative, missing audit/monitoring, missing migration, or skipped local governance.
schedule_phase.zh: 使用 schedule timezone recurrence contract-first workflow：只读 Schedule Contract Inspector 先固定 timezone source、user timezone fallback、本地周一 09:00 语义、DST spring-forward/fall-back 样本、missed-run catch-up window、retry/provider replay idempotency key、subscription/disabled/tenant/locale filters、provider delivery/failure surface、audit fields、monitoring、migration 和 local governance proof targets；Digest Scheduler Builder 读取 contract handoff 后才实现；Temporal Correctness Inspector 与 Delivery Audit Inspector 使用同一个 parallel_group 并行读取 contract 与 builder handoff，分别反证多时区本地时间、DST 前后、missed-run catch-up once、duplicate retry/replay negatives、timezone version drift，以及 unsubscribe/disabled/tenant/locale negatives、provider reconciliation、scheduled_at/due_at/sent_at/skipped_reason/timezone_version/job_run_id audit、monitoring、compatibility 和 governance claims；GateKeeper 汇总所有 handoff 和 evidence_query，对 cron-only、local-trigger-only、UTC-only、single-timezone-only、provider-accepted-only、missing DST boundary、missing catch-up/idempotency negative、missing unsubscribe/disabled negative、missing audit/monitoring、missing migration 或 skipped local governance fail closed。
schedule_phase.es: Usar schedule timezone recurrence contract-first workflow: Schedule Contract Inspector fija timezone source, local Monday 09:00, DST, catch-up, replay/idempotency, subscription/disabled/tenant/locale filters, provider delivery/failure, audit fields, monitoring, migration y governance; Digest Scheduler Builder implementa desde ese handoff; Temporal Correctness Inspector y Delivery Audit Inspector leen contract y builder handoffs en el mismo parallel_group, refutando timezone/DST/catch-up/duplicate replay/version drift y unsubscribe/disabled/tenant/locale/provider reconciliation/audit/monitoring/compatibility/governance claims; GateKeeper fail closed ante cron-only, local-trigger-only, UTC-only, single-timezone-only, provider-accepted-only, missing DST, catch-up/idempotency, subscription negatives, audit/monitoring, migration o governance.

search_index_consistency.en: Use a search index consistency contract-first workflow: read-only Search Index Contract Inspector first freezes document event schema, search engine / provider contract fixtures, create/update/delete sync semantics, tenant ACL and permission-change rules, index alias/versioning, reindex/backfill cursor and idempotency, watermark recovery, lag SLO/alerts, pagination/sort stability samples, audit fields, retry/DLQ behavior, and local-governance proof targets; Search Index Builder implements only after that contract handoff; Index Consistency Inspector and Access Freshness Inspector read contract plus builder handoffs in one parallel_group, separately refuting create/update/delete fixtures, deleted-document negative search, reindex/backfill idempotent reruns, cursor recovery after failure, stale index lag alerts, pagination/sort stability, tenant ACL changes, permission revocation, unauthorized-document negative results, cross-tenant negatives, audit logs, retry/DLQ, monitoring, and governance; GateKeeper combines all handoffs and evidence_query so Weak, Unproven, Blocking, local-search-only, green-index-job-only, row-count-sample-only, dashboard-latest-only, missing ACL negatives, missing deleted-document proof, missing reindex idempotency, missing cursor recovery, missing lag alert, missing audit, or skipped local governance states are exposed before closure and fail closed.
search_index_consistency.zh: 使用 search index consistency contract-first workflow：只读 Search Index Contract Inspector 先固定 document event schema、search engine / provider contract fixtures、create/update/delete sync semantics、tenant ACL 与 permission-change rules、index alias/versioning、reindex/backfill cursor 和 idempotency、watermark recovery、lag SLO/alerts、pagination/sort stability samples、audit fields、retry/DLQ behavior 和 local governance proof targets；Search Index Builder 读取 contract handoff 后才实现；Index Consistency Inspector 与 Access Freshness Inspector 使用同一个 parallel_group 并行读取 contract 与 builder handoff，分别反证 create/update/delete fixtures、deleted-document negative search、reindex/backfill idempotent reruns、cursor recovery after failure、stale index lag alert、pagination/sort stability，以及 tenant ACL changes、permission revocation、unauthorized-document negative results、cross-tenant negatives、audit logs、retry/DLQ、monitoring 和 governance；GateKeeper 汇总所有 handoff 和 evidence_query，让 Weak、Unproven、Blocking、local-search-only、green-index-job-only、row-count-sample-only、dashboard-latest-only、missing ACL negatives、missing deleted-document proof、missing reindex idempotency、missing cursor recovery、missing lag alert、missing audit 或 skipped local governance 在 closure 前暴露并 fail closed。
search_index_consistency.es: Usar search index consistency contract-first workflow: Search Index Contract Inspector fija event schema, search engine / provider contract fixtures, create/update/delete, tenant ACL, permission changes, alias/versioning, reindex/backfill cursor e idempotency, watermark recovery, lag SLO/alerts, pagination/sort samples, audit fields, retry/DLQ y governance; Search Index Builder implementa desde ese handoff; Index Consistency Inspector y Access Freshness Inspector leen contract y builder handoffs en el mismo parallel_group, refutando create/update/delete fixtures, deleted-document negatives, idempotent reindex, cursor recovery, lag alerts, pagination/sort stability, tenant ACL changes, permission revocation, unauthorized negatives, cross-tenant negatives, audit, retry/DLQ, monitoring y governance; GateKeeper expone Weak, Unproven, Blocking y fake-done states antes de closure y fail closed ante local-search-only, green-index-job-only, row-count-sample-only, dashboard-latest-only, missing ACL negatives, deleted-document proof, reindex idempotency, cursor recovery, lag alert, audit o governance.

search_quality.en: Use a search quality evaluation workflow: first freeze eval set, negative queries, regression samples, Top-5 baseline, and human-review rubric; Builder changes retrieval/ranking; Quality Inspector compares before/after, real queries, negatives, regression samples, relevance, groundedness, and hallucination risk; GateKeeper reads baseline, builder, quality handoffs, and evidence_query so Weak, Unproven, Blocking, demo-query-only, single-score-only, or cherry-picked-query evidence is exposed and fails closed.
search_quality.zh: 使用 search quality evaluation workflow：先冻结 eval set、负向查询、回归样本、Top-5 baseline 和人工评审 rubric，再让 Builder 修改检索/排序策略；Quality Inspector 比较 before/after、真实查询、负例、回归样本、relevance、groundedness 和 hallucination risk；GateKeeper 汇入 baseline、builder、quality handoffs 与 evidence_query，让 Weak、Unproven、Blocking、demo-query-only、single-score-only 或 cherry-picked-query 在 closure 前暴露并 fail closed。
search_quality.es: Usar search quality evaluation workflow: baseline fija eval set, negativos, regresión, Top-5 y rúbrica humana; Builder cambia retrieval/ranking; Quality Inspector compara before/after, relevancia, groundedness y hallucination risk; GateKeeper decide desde handoffs y evidence_query para exponer Weak, Unproven, Blocking, demo-query-only o single-score-only antes de fail closed.

rag_long_chain.en: Use a long-chain RAG workflow because ingestion, retrieval ACL, answer/tool gating, eval review, and evidence hardening produce distinct proof targets and handoffs; GateKeeper reads contract, evaluation, hardening handoffs, and verified evidence so Weak, Unproven, Blocking, fake-done, demo-only, plausible-answer, embedding-search-only, or UI-citation-only states surface and fail closed before closure.
rag_long_chain.zh: 使用 long-chain RAG workflow，因为 ingestion、retrieval ACL、answer/tool gating、eval review 和 evidence hardening 会分别产生 distinct proof target 与 handoff；GateKeeper 汇入 contract、evaluation、hardening handoffs 与 verified evidence，让 Weak、Unproven、Blocking、fake-done、demo-only、plausible-answer、embedding-search-only 或 UI-citation-only 在 closure 前暴露并转入 evidence hardening 或 fail closed。
rag_long_chain.es: Usar un workflow RAG long-chain porque ingestion, retrieval ACL, answer/tool gating, eval review y evidence hardening producen proof targets y handoffs distintos; GateKeeper lee contract, evaluation, hardening y evidence_query para exponer Weak, Unproven, Blocking, fake-done, demo-only o UI-citation-only antes de cerrar.
